passages.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. An institution should identify each customer and verify that identity using independent and reliable source documents before the account is used. Placeholder passage for testing only.

passages.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Where the same identity document, identity number or address proof is presented in support of more than one account, the institution should record the duplication and establish whether an innocent explanation exists, such as a joint account, a family member or a business owner. Duplication alone is not evidence of wrongdoing. Placeholder passage for testing only.

passages.citation: PLACEHOLDER-AML-HANDBOOK s.P-3 (SYNTHETIC - NOT A REAL CITATION)
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Reuse of one identity across accounts held at different institutions warrants closer review than reuse within a single institution, because no single institution can observe it. The reviewing institution should weigh the reuse together with account velocity, pass-through behaviour and network structure rather than acting on the reuse on its own. Placeholder passage for testing only.

passages.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Transactions should be monitored on an ongoing basis so that activity inconsistent with the customer's stated profile, including rapid pass-through of funds and sudden increases in transfer velocity, is escalated for review. Placeholder passage for testing only.

passages.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Indicators associated with mule activity include newly opened accounts that immediately receive and forward funds, accounts that retain little or no balance after forwarding, shared devices or identity documents between otherwise unrelated account holders, and layered transfers that cross institutional boundaries. Placeholder passage for testing only.
